name: Singlet Bell state CHSH correlation S=2*sqrt(2)
task_prompt: Prepare the two-qubit singlet Bell state in Qiskit and evaluate a CHSH operator with StatevectorEstimator. Choose the measurement observables consistently so the expected absolute value is 2*sqrt(2), print all four correlators and S, and assert |S| agrees with 2*sqrt(2) within 1e-12 and exceeds the classical bound 2. Output code only as a self-contained Python program. Use documented public APIs, require no cloud credentials, make stochastic behavior reproducible, and include executable checks with justified tolerances.
